## Code Review

This pull request configures `vanilla_mbridge=True` across several NPU-based test scripts and updates the save frequency in the FSDP2 NPU script. Two critical issues were identified in the review: a typo in `run_grpo_qwen3_30b_megatron_sglang_npu.sh` where the actor configuration is mistakenly overridden instead of the reference model, and a syntax error in `run_gspo_qwen3_30b_megatron_npu.sh` caused by an unnecessary trailing backslash inside a bash array.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The [consumer version of Gemini Code Assist on GitHub](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/review-repo-code) is being sunset. Starting **June 18, 2026**, new organization installations will be blocked, and all code review activity will officially cease on **July 17, 2026**.
> For more details on the timeline and next steps, please review the [Help Documentation](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/deprecations/consumer-code-review).

![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

Inside the `REF_CONFIG` array, the configuration should apply to the reference model (`actor_rollout_ref.ref.megatron...`) rather than the actor model (`actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron...`). This typo overrides the actor's configuration again instead of configuring the reference model.

```suggestion
    actor_rollout_ref.ref.megatron.vanilla_mbridge=True
```

![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

Inside a bash array definition `REF=( ... )`, elements are separated by whitespace, and line continuation backslashes are not needed. Adding a trailing backslash `\` escapes the newline and the closing parenthesis `)`, causing a bash syntax error (e.g., `syntax error near unexpected token ')'`). Remove the trailing backslash.

```suggestion
    actor_rollout_ref.ref.megatron.vanilla_mbridge=True
```
